metadata.title: Enable U Outcome Streams
metadata.description: Ten outcome-based streams connecting the customer jobs to implementation bricks across assessment, delivery, operations, public-sector trust, data and transactions.
metadata.flowModelNote: Flows and ownership boundaries are modeled from public product and service evidence; they are not a claim about Enable U's internal process implementation.

rootGroups.name: Plan and Modernize

streams.name: Define Integration Strategy and Roadmap
streams.description: Turn strategic need and runtime evidence into a sequenced, funded integration roadmap with explicit ownership and measurable outcomes.
outcomes: A shared fact base replaces competing middleware narratives
The first investment wave reduces material service risk
Every target pattern has build-and-run ownership

flows.title: Define Integration Strategy and Roadmap
flows.description: Turn strategic need and runtime evidence into a sequenced, funded integration roadmap with explicit ownership and measurable outcomes.
flows.trigger: A renewal, incident pattern, acquisition or cloud mandate makes the current integration estate untenable.
flows.successSignal: Decision makers approve a costed first wave with customer outcome, guardrails, owner and retirement target.

steps.title: Baseline the estate and outcomes
keyFacts: Inventory combines systems, contracts, message flows, data classes, owners and observed service history.
painPoints: Architecture repositories rarely match deployed reality.

dependencies.how: Supports 'baseline the estate and outcomes' through integration inventory and tenant control.

steps.title: Segment risk and change pressure

streams.name: Migrate Legacy Integrations to Hybrid Cloud
streams.description: Move integrations from heritage middleware to managed, Azure, Boomi or OpenTunnel runtimes in reversible waves while old and new paths coexist.
outcomes: Customer services continue through every cutover
Mappings and contracts are reconciled before retirement
Duplicate runtime shrinks after each wave

flows.title: Migrate Legacy Integrations to Hybrid Cloud
flows.description: Move integrations from heritage middleware to managed, Azure, Boomi or OpenTunnel runtimes in reversible waves while old and new paths coexist.
flows.trigger: A heritage runtime reaches end of support, becomes too costly or blocks cloud adoption.
flows.successSignal: A cohort runs on the target platform with reconciled outcomes, tested rollback and approved retirement of the old path.

steps.title: Discover compatibility and hidden coupling
keyFacts: Runtime traces and configuration reveal schemas, schedules, side effects and downstream consumers.
painPoints: Documentation misses undocumented batch order and operator workarounds.

dependencies.name: Legacy and Cloud Migration Tooling
dependencies.description: Discovery, compatibility tests, shadow traffic, reconciliation, cohort cutover, rollback and retirement evidence for phased migration between integration runtimes.
dependencies.how: Supports 'discover compatibility and hidden coupling' through legacy and cloud migration tooling.

steps.title: Build the target flow from governed assets
keyFacts: Contracts, mappings and connectors are versioned independently of runtime-specific configuration.
painPoints: A lift-and-shift carries old coupling into the cloud.

steps.title: Shadow traffic and reconcile outcomes
keyFacts: Old and new paths process representative cohorts while business keys and results are compared.
painPoints: Technical success can hide missing or duplicated business outcomes.

dependencies.name: Legacy and Cloud Migration Tooling
dependencies.description: Discovery, compatibility tests, shadow traffic, reconciliation, cohort cutover, rollback and retirement evidence for phased migration between integration runtimes.
dependencies.how: Supports 'shadow traffic and reconcile outcomes' through legacy and cloud migration tooling.

dependencies.name: End-to-End Monitoring and Track/Trace
dependencies.description: Business-chain health, message correlation, backlog age, dependency telemetry, privacy-aware diagnostics, alerting and guarded recovery across all supported runtimes.

steps.title: Cut over progressively and retire
keyFacts: Health gates control cohort expansion; rollback remains possible until reconciliation closes.

dependencies.how: Supports 'cut over progressively and retire' through end-to-end monitoring and track/trace.

dependencies.name: Cloud Connector Edge Gateway
dependencies.description: Customer-side hardened connector that establishes outbound trusted connectivity from on-premises networks to managed integration services while preserving local endpoint reachability.
dependencies.how: Supports 'cut over progressively and retire' through cloud connector edge gateway.
